plan.title: RFQ Template Dropdown Excludes Technical Templates

steps.note: Open the multi-stage RFX creation screen.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Configure both the Technical and Commercial RFQ stages required by the scenario.
Move to the technical stage so it is configured before checking the commercial stage.
Apply a technical-stage template before inspecting the RFQ selector.
Navigate to the commercial RFQ stage whose template dropdown is under test.
Inspect the templates offered by the RFQ selector; the catalog can observe the list but lacks the named or semantic assertions needed to prove technical templates are absent.
